One day, while undergoing intensive 
training for the URA Finals—

You meet an outstanding Trainer from your 
class, Aoi Kiryuin, and her trainee, Happy 
Meek.

Watching the two nurture a bond despite 
their clumsiness, the Trainer felt their 
feelings for their own Umamusume grow even 
stronger.
